rca_of_issue: Root cause: In server.py /api/dashboard (line ~321), the code computes `total_forecast = sum(t.target for t in monthly_targets)` over ALL forecast rows, including the manager's row (rohit1.singh has pipeline deals worth ~₹23.5L / ₹2Cr = 11.76%). Reps get `team_target * (my_forecast / total_forecast)`, so cumulatively they receive 88.24% of ₹2Cr = ₹17,647,058, and 11.76% (~₹23.5L) is stranded. The manager still sees the full ₹2Cr (correct), but the invariant 'sum of rep targets ≈ team total' is violated. Reproduction: `pytest backend/tests/test_monthly_target.py::test_sum_of_rep_targets_matches_team_total`. Mitigation: when computing total_forecast, filter out entries whose salesperson_email is in MANAGER_EMAILS (or restrict to users where role=='rep'). Verified manually by summing 8 rep dashboard.monthly.target values from the live API — the deficit (₹2,352,941.18) equals rohit1.singh's proportional share exactly, confirming the diagnosis.
